Flow.description: Creates a Purchase Record (bill) for an existing customer. One screen laid out like the Convert screen: Customer, Bill, Product Purchase Details (SKU Searcher) and Loyalty Redemption. On Save the bill is created (the trigger checks the redemption, applies the discount and redeems points), then one Purchase Line Item on the bill and one Asset on the customer per product picked; if the products cannot be saved the bill is rolled back too. Launched from the New Purchase list button on Purchase Record.
